### Twenty One Capital CEO Raphael Zagury to Speak at Bitcoin Asia 2026 in Hong Kong


August 20, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/307816567/files/doc_news/Twenty-One-Capital-CEO-Raphael-Zagury-to-Speak-at-Bitcoin-Asia-2026-in-Hong-Kong-2026.pdf)


*Session to be Livestreamed on the Bitcoin Magazine YouTube Channel*


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI) today announced that Chief Executive Officer Raphael Zagury will speak at Bitcoin Asia 2026, taking place August 27–28, 2026 at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Hong Kong.


Mr. Zagury will present a session titled *“Here Be Dragons: Bitcoin’s First Ever Hashrate Bear Market”* on the Nakamoto Stage on Friday, August 28 at 11:25 a.m. Hong Kong Time (11:25 p.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, August 27). The session will examine the forces behind the current mining reset and what it means for miners, investors, decentralization, and Bitcoin’s long-term security model.


**Bitcoin Asia 2026 Details**


- **Dates:** August 27–28, 2026
- **Venue:** Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, Hong Kong
- **Session:** “Here Be Dragons: Bitcoin’s First Ever Hashrate Bear Market”
- **Speaker:** Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer, Twenty One Capital
- **Date and Time:** Friday, August 28, 2026 at 11:25 a.m. HKT (11:25 p.m. ET on Thursday, August 27)
- **Stage:** Nakamoto Stage
- **Session Page:**[asia.b.tc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.b.tc%2Fagenda%2Fhere-be-dragons-bitcoin-s-first-ever-hashrate-bear-market-2026-08-28-11-25-am-nakamoto-stage&esheet=54592102&newsitemid=20260820134692&lan=en-US&anchor=asia.b.tc&index=1&md5=7605751ed941997b60198bba91ee39ae)


**How to Watch**


The session will be livestreamed on the Bitcoin Magazine YouTube channel as part of the Bitcoin Asia Day Two broadcast, available at[youtube.com/@BitcoinMagazine](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40BitcoinMagazine%2Fstreams&esheet=54592102&newsitemid=20260820134692&lan=en-US&anchor=youtube.com%2F%40BitcoinMagazine&index=2&md5=d2a4fe29e07e5140a2e1837ec409023e) . Additional conference information is available at[asia.b.tc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.b.tc%2F&esheet=54592102&newsitemid=20260820134692&lan=en-US&anchor=asia.b.tc&index=3&md5=2766cd5fddff8e6ee56eaea4a6ffdd62) .


Investors and members of the media interested in scheduling a meeting with Twenty One management during the conference should contactxxi@kcsa.com .


**About Twenty One**


Twenty One is a Bitcoin-focused operating company. Designed to pair one of the largest Bitcoin treasuries in the public markets with operating businesses, Twenty One aims to provide shareholders with direct, capital-efficient exposure to Bitcoin through a growing Bitcoin-native platform. For more information, visit[https://investors.xxi.money/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&esheet=54592102&newsitemid=20260820134692&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&index=4&md5=2ad540a59654812d64eb394b877181f2) .
